basic_info.description: Welcome to your new home! This recently renovated property offers comfort and classic charms with a light filled spacious living room, 2 bedrooms and 1 full bath.  The dining area is adjacent to the updated kitchen. The lower-level offers bonus rooms with full bath and wet bar which can be used as additional living spaces. The expansive backyard offers ample space for relaxation and possible ADU due to extra large lot. Located in a desirable neighborhood with close proximity to public transportations and freeway access.  Minutes to Stonestown Mall and H-Mart.  Easy access to SF State and City College.   Whether you're a 1st time home buyer or an investor, this home will be perfect for the new owner.
